The §3Chicago Pile§r is a low-tech, modular breeding reactor with no GUI, built to transmute §6Natural Uranium§r into plutonium isotopes such as §6Plutonium-239§r and §6Reactor-Grade Plutonium§r through neutron bombardment. It must be operated manually or via §dRedstone-over-Radio§r; §3Chicago Pile Fuel Loaders§r, §3Chicago Pile Vents§r, and §3Chicago Pile Control Rods§r can be automated with Redstone-over-Radio.

Build a filled rectangular prism of §6Chicago Pile Graphite Bricks§r, at minimum 5x5x5 and at most 15x15x15. It does not need to be a perfect cube. Shapes like 5x7x9 are valid as long as all dimensions stay within limits and the shape is filled. Once assembled, right-click with the §6Hand Drill§r on a non-edge block on one lateral face to establish the core and fix the reactor's channel orientation. Using the hand drill on other sides creates holes needed for the reactor's mechanisms. Channels are straight lines drilled through the pile and may not intersect.

The front side of the reactor houses the fuel inputs, and the opposite side houses the fuel outputs. Fuel channels share the core's face orientation and accept rods via a §3Chicago Pile Fuel Loader§r on the input port; spent rods are ejected from the opposite side. Ventilation channels run perpendicular to the core and require a §3Chicago Pile Vent§r supplied with §bCompressed Air§r at §e1 PU§r. Each vent cools only the fuel channels within one block above or below it. Vertical control rod channels on top are optional and reduce reactivity between channels; they are useful for more precise fuel breeding. None of these mechanisms can intersect with each other.

Every reaction requires a neutron source. The §6Ra226Be Neutron Source§r is the starter option; the more powerful §6Po210Be Neutron Source§r can replace it later. §6Natural Uranium Rods§r breed into §6Plutonium-239 Rods§r, which can be bred further into §6Reactor-Grade Plutonium Rods§r. Leaving fuel beyond that point produces §6Nuclear Waste Rods§r, which generate extreme heat and risk meltdown. To safely push out spent rods without fresh fuel, use §6Zirconium Rods§r. They are inert and transparent to neutrons.

§2Verify cooling is working before loading any fuel. The pile melts down at 800°C, causing an explosion and widespread fire.

Quest requirements: Build a §3Chicago Pile§r of at least 5x5x5 with a core established, attach a §3Chicago Pile Fuel Loader§r and a §3Chicago Pile Vent§r, and load a §6Ra226Be Neutron Source§r alongside at least one §6Natural Uranium Rod§r.

[F1] For more information.
